location_name: Malaysian waters (incl. Terengganu and Kelantan waters, South China Sea)
summary: Malaysian maritime enforcement recorded 103 cases of arrests of foreign fishermen intruding into Malaysian waters in 2010, according to figures later given to the Dewan Rakyat; in one instance the Malaysian Maritime Enforcement Agency detained nine Vietnamese boats with 95 crew off Terengganu and Kelantan in August 2010.
actors: Malaysian Maritime Enforcement Agency (MMEA/APMM), Eastern Region
